answer: Make every new agent anchor its identity to a slow, costly history rather than a cheap key. Think of reputation as a prism: one raw signal, like staked tokens, gets split into separate bands such as task quality, peer review accuracy and account age, and a sybil swarm cannot fake all bands at once. Weight votes by the weakest band, so spinning up a thousand fresh wallets buys almost nothing. Trust should accrue like ferrous rust, gradually and visibly, never in one burst.
